options: Only when the page opens with an image section

settings.label: Shading behind the header
settings.desc: A soft gradient behind the bar so the logo and menu stay readable over a photograph. Raise it on bright images.

settings.label: Count this header in full-height sections
settings.desc: Full-height sections such as the hero subtract the header so they end exactly at the bottom of the screen. Turn this off to let them fill the whole screen instead.

settings.label: Default category marker
settings.desc: What shows next to each collection link in a mega menu. Individual mega menus can override this in their own panel settings.

settings.label: Mega menu columns
settings.desc: Packed spreads the groups across a fixed number of columns and stacks short groups under each other, instead of giving every group a column of its own.

settings.label: Packed columns
settings.desc: How many columns the groups are spread across. Fewer columns means more short groups sharing one. Narrow screens use fewer automatically.

settings.label: Background video (mobile)

settings.label: Content width

settings.label: Placeholder image
